criterion: Classify the complete asserted operation, not the vocabulary of its labels or degree of scientific support. Ordering/reset of predefined role slots is formal. A rule that supplies or changes interpreted referential/action content by carrying or interrupting context is functional. Neither classification establishes the interpretation as true.

recommendations.claim: Pass335 orders the twelve workshop programs into six writing slots: reference/following, material/measure, process/transfer, duration/state, target/application, and readiness/closure. Slots may be omitted or contain several cards; return to an earlier slot starts a new microstep within the same statement. Rare cards remain learned from an exemplar rather than being generated by this ordering alone.
recommendations.reason: The complete claim orders already named roles, permits empty/multiple slots and inserts a microstep boundary when slot order descends. It assigns no particular written form to a meaning, supplies no omitted participant/action and does not change the material referent on that boundary. Retained learned whole cards are an architecture limitation. Named semantic slots do not turn this ordering rule into an additional content claim.

recommendations.claim: Pass293 raises the candidate slot order Selektor → Quelle/Ziel → Menge → Tätigkeit → Posten/Schluss for its sixty-four slot frames, explicitly asking whether this order works or individual families require another syntax. recommendations.reason: Same classification principle as335: the prospective selector/source-target/amount/activity/item-close sequence is an ordering alternative over predefined roles. Its untested status is preserved but is not the reason it is formal.

recommendations.claim: GDT416 resolves repeated but unwritten verbs or items by continuing the active action and active argument only within the same page and visible owner. It treats these carries as ellipsis in card/cell writing, not additional missing written words; fluent imperative output is a workshop paraphrase, not deciphered plaintext. GDT562 later states that the old GDT416 edition stores no source-event IDs; its earlier audit is not equivalent to that later event-pointer provenance.
recommendations.reason: The full claim interprets absent repeated action/argument material through continuing the active action and argument inside the same page and owner. It supplies a specific ellipsis/reference function, not only a boundary or output arrangement. Assumed vocabulary does not remove that functional interpretation. The lack of old source-event IDs remains a separate provenance limit.

## Grenze

Die Ausgabe ist unser bestes ausführbares Bedeutungsmodell, nicht entschlüsselter
Klartext. Die deutschen Wörter sind breite Arbeitswerte. Das lokale Sachwissen
bleibt weiterhin im Bild, in der Rubrik oder im Werkstattexemplar.

specific_comparison.DE335_vs_DN293: Both specify ordering of existing role slots;335 adds a slot-return microstep boundary but does not assert a new material/referent meaning. The applied versus prospective status does not justify a type difference.
specific_comparison.DE335_vs_DN416: 335 segments a work-step representation;416 resolves missing interpreted arguments/actions. Their boundary conditions do not make their whole claims identical.
specific_comparison.DJ347_limit: Functional classification rests only on the material-thread interruption claim. Its local/source-derived status remains explicit. Merely enumerating synchronized trace fields would not justify this type. The initial DJ draft used formal_role; this peer independently accepts the integrated functional type on the narrower reference-function criterion, not because the nearby H3/B2 handoff has rich content.
specific_comparison.DN413: 413 asserts what kind of interpreted content each class contributes and where referential knowledge comes from. Unlike335 it is not merely a sequence of predefined roles; unlike a species gloss it remains an architecture-level content hypothesis.

limits: Only these five complete propositions; no blanket reclassification of semantic slot names.
No new scientific finding, lexical meaning, source identification or experimental permission.
